        nodes = seg['nodes']
        color_pixels = {}

            break
    
    # Try ACTION7

    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    color_pixels = {}
    for n in nodes:
        c = n['color']
        color_pixels[c] = color_pixels.get(c, 0) + n['pixels']
    print(f"\nAfter ACTION7: W={color_pixels.get('W',0)}, p={color_pixels.get('p',0)}, S={color_pixels.get('S',0)}")
    print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed', False)}")
